title: High Latency & Packet Degradation
description: Troubleshooting procedure for high latency, packet loss, bandwidth saturation, or buffer congestion.
steps: Check interface bandwidth utilization and drop counters
Inspect top talkers and NetFlow traffic flow stats for anomalies
Check CPU/Memory load on core forwarding engines
Perform traceroute/path inspection to locate hop degradation
Verify upstream ISP link stability and SLA metrics
